assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are repository provisional geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Areas, topology, maps, and metrics demonstrate internal package consistency only and must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, setbacks, ownership, utilities, fire, heritage, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road width, and statutory conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: No verified building-level current-condition, ownership, structural, fire, heritage, or life-cycle-carbon survey is available.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are capacity-test blocks only; no retain-renovate-demolish decision is made.

assumptions.statement: Passenger flow, traffic capacity, station exits, curb operation, parking, and accessibility audits are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Roads and branches are concept centerlines rather than road redlines or capacity claims.

assumptions.statement: No approved scenario operator, field samples, service parity audit, or public-trust baseline exists.
assumptions.impact: Operational performance metrics remain unknown and all high-impact scenarios retain human stop and takeover.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used to compare mechanisms, not to claim local adoption or statutory applicability.
assumptions.impact: Spatial form, governance authority, performance, and legal effect are not transferred to Jing-Zhang without local review.
